9902804f4ff89428.name: National Child Support Enforcement Association
9902804f4ff89428.description: NCSEA, now named the National Child Support Engagement Association in its 2026 bylaws, provides education, networking and policy advocacy for child-support professionals.
9902804f4ff89428.identity_evidence: Official historical NCSEA publications use National Child Support Enforcement Association, while current June 2026 bylaws name National Child Support Engagement Association. Same official domain, acronym and child-support mission support continuity; exact effective rename date was not established. Article II section 2.6 refers to nonprofit corporate powers under Minnesota law. Original filing name retained; this association is separate from the federal Office of Child Support Enforcement.
